entities.summary: Hampus Lindholm is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman and alternate captain for the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL). Lindholm began his ice hockey career with Jonstorps IF and previously played with Rögle BK. He then played with the Anaheim Ducks for his first eight seasons in the NHL, before being traded to Boston.
